headline: Poddar Housing and Development Limited: Delisting
sum: Delisting - Members of the Exchange are hereby informed about the compulsory delisting of Equity Shares of Poddar Housing and Development Limited w.e.f. October 16, 2026 in terms of Regulation 32(1) of Securities and Exchange Board of…
detail: Delisting - Members of the Exchange are hereby informed about the compulsory delisting of Equity Shares of Poddar Housing and Development Limited w.e.f. October 16, 2026 in terms of Regulation 32(1) of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Delisting of Equity Shares) Regulations, 2021, Section 21A of the Securities Contract (Regulations) Act, 1956, Securities Contract (Regulations) Rules, 1957 and Bye-Laws and Regulations of National Stock Exchange of India Limited ("Exchange").
